result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` module tests ran with no failures reported. I didn't add tests for the new matches, and I didn't run the conventions against sample files, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `build-gradle.js` cases are unchecked.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, a duplicated `html`. They are now `(html|htm|xhtml)`.
- **Generated code:** the .NET `<doc>` XML rule and the `// Generated by` JavaScript rule had a path pattern of `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only matches a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle scripts:** the build-and-deployment rule had `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which wants a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The content patterns are untouched. I assumed the `<doc>` and `// Generated by` content checks match a whole line, as the other rules do. A `.js` or `.xml` file only goes to the generated scope if it has that line in its first 1–2 lines.

I didn't commit anything.
